verdict.rationale: Gram's Connect page lists every tool source (OpenAPI, Functions, third-party, custom/tunneled MCP servers) and provides an in-dashboard harness to authenticate, chat with a model that calls tools, and inspect logs before connecting a real client, plus a 'verify' step that probes reachability/protocol — all indicating pre-connection inspection. However, there is no explicit documentation showing per-tool input schema viewers or explicit hosting/transport attribute displays beyond source-type categorization. missing for 10: explicit input-schema viewer evidence, explicit transport/hosting attribute display beyond source-type labels, independent hands-on confirmation.
